milestones.outcome: The core and workbench host resolve the unique closest same-basename counterpart from the complete accepted catalogue without scanning it per gesture.
exit_criteria: Pure core checks cover supported suffixes, exact basename spelling, same-directory preference, trailing-directory proximity and ambiguous-best no-op.
The public workbench host resolves visible and withheld accepted entries, deduplicates stable identity, excludes old rename aliases and refuses unavailable catalogues.
Large-catalogue repeated resolution performs indexed work without blob reads or whole-file projections; focused core/host, architecture, format and documentation checks pass.
milestones.boundary: Matching and accepted-catalogue resolution only. Native QAction, physical keyboard, active-tab navigation and full RFC acceptance belong to the next milestone.

milestones.outcome: View > Go to header/source and Alt/Option+O navigate the active review tab through the ordinary exact comparison path, with rendered and key-event acceptance.
exit_criteria: All six amended RFC acceptance criteria pass through the real command and composed review, including hidden targets, exact older comparisons, stale work, focus, editor input and inactive modalities.
Command-map and navigation architecture documentation, RFC baseline comparison, verification ledger and terminal tracker state agree with the actual tested candidate.
milestones.boundary: Full authorized RFC acceptance and upkeep. No human or native evidence is inferred; only explicit remaining human criteria require attendance.
